picker.title: Choose from the media library
picker.description: Pick an existing item or upload a new one.
picker.emptyHint: Upload a file to get started.

media.title: Media library
media.description: Photos, PDFs and videos used across the website.
media.emptyHint: Drag files here or use the upload button.
media.dropHint: JPG, PNG, WebP, PDF, MP4, MP3 — images are optimised and their location data removed.
media.uploaded: {count, plural, one {# file uploaded} other {# files uploaded}}
media.addVideoHint: YouTube, Vimeo or Facebook video link (https).
media.creditHint: Photographer or source, shown under the image.
media.altHint: Describe the image for people using screen readers. Tetum is used when a language is empty.
media.inUse: This item is still in use (for example as a post cover). Replace it there first, then delete it.
media.deleteDescription: It will be removed from the library. Content that already embeds it keeps working.

editor.linkHint: https://…, mailto:, tel: or an internal path such as /tet/news. Leave empty to remove the link.
editor.invalidLink: Use a full https:// address, mailto:, tel: or a path starting with /.
editor.invalidYoutube: This is not a valid YouTube link.

posts.title: News & articles
posts.description: News, press releases, articles and political statements.
posts.emptyHint: Write the first news item or press release.
posts.readOnly: You can read this post but not change it.

fields.title: Title
fields.slugHint: Optional — generated from the title. Letters, numbers and dashes only.
fields.excerptHint: One or two sentences shown on cards and in search results.

posts.titleRequired: Add a title in at least one language.
posts.author: Author
posts.saveFirst: Save the draft first; publishing options appear afterwards.
posts.publishHint: An editor with publishing rights will review and publish it.
posts.noPublishPermission: You are not allowed to publish.
posts.municipalityHint: Optional — for news about a specific município.
posts.attachmentHint: A published document from the Documents section.
posts.bylineHint: Optional — e.g. the author's name for opinion articles.
posts.scheduleDescription: The post goes live automatically at this time.
posts.scheduleFuture: Choose a time in the future.
posts.deleteDescription: It disappears from the website and the backoffice. The deletion is recorded in the audit log.

date.label: Publish date
date.invalid: Choose a valid date and time.
date.hint: Past date: the post shows that date. Future date: it is published automatically at that time.
date.futureLive: The post will be hidden from the site until then.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Statutes, programmes, resolutions and other official PDFs.
documents.emptyHint: Add the party statute, political programme or resolutions.
documents.publicHint: Visible and downloadable on the website.
documents.fileHint: Pick a PDF from the library or upload one.
documents.titleRequired: Add a title in at least one language.
documents.deleteDescription: It will no longer be listed or downloadable. Posts that attach it lose the attachment.

leadership.title: Leadership & offices
leadership.description: Party organs, municipal committees and branch offices.
leadership.emptyHint: Add the presidency, central committee and municipal committees.
leadership.municipalityRequired: Choose the município for a municipal committee member.
leadership.termOrder: The term must end after it starts.
leadership.positionRequired: Add the position in at least one language.
leadership.deleteDescription: {name} will be removed from the leadership list. This cannot be undone.

branches.title: Branch offices
branches.emptyHint: Add the national headquarters and the offices in each município.
branches.name: Office name
branches.coordinatorHint: Chosen from the leadership entries of this município.
branches.noCoordinators: Add leadership entries for this município first.
branches.openingHoursHint: Free text per language, e.g. Mon–Fri 08:00–17:00.
branches.coordsBoth: Enter both latitude and longitude, or neither.
branches.deleteDescription: {name} will be removed from the municipal directory. This cannot be undone.

site.title: Website
site.description: Static pages, home page slides, photo albums and site settings.

pageHints.ABOUT: Sections of the “About PST” page, in display order.
pageHints.HISTORY: Chapters of the party history, in display order.
pageHints.IDEOLOGY: Principles and ideology, in display order.
pageHints.PROGRAM: Programme pillars — each one can have an icon.

site.noSectionsHint: Add the first section of this page.
site.iconHintProgram: Lucide icon name shown on the programme card, e.g. graduation-cap, heart-pulse, sprout.
site.iconUnknown: Unknown icon name — pick one from the suggestions.
site.titleRequired: Add a title in at least one language.
site.deleteSectionDescription: The section and all its translations will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

hero.description: Slides rotating at the top of the home page, in display order.
hero.emptyHint: Without slides the home page shows the default banner.
hero.imageHint: Wide photo, at least 1600 px across.
hero.ctaHrefHint: Internal path (/membership) or https:// link. Leave empty for no button.
hero.ctaHrefInvalid: Use a path starting with / or an https:// link.
hero.windowOrder: The end must be after the start.
hero.headline: Headline
hero.headlineRequired: Add a headline in at least one language.
hero.deleteDescription: It will disappear from the home page. The image stays in the media library.

albums.title: Album
albums.description: Photo galleries shown in the website gallery.
albums.emptyHint: Create an album and add photos from the media library.
albums.itemCount: {count, plural, =0 {no items} one {# item} other {# items}}
albums.titleRequired: Add a title in at least one language.
albums.coverHint: If empty, the first photo is used.
albums.unsavedItems: You changed the photos — save to apply.
albums.caption: Caption
albums.deleteDescription: The album is deleted; its photos stay in the media library.

settings.superAdminOnly: Only super admins can change these settings. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
settings.mottoHint: The official motto is in Portuguese and is shown untranslated.
settings.headquartersHint: Shown in the footer and on the contact page.
settings.socialHint: Full https:// links. Leave empty to hide.
settings.membershipHint: These rules apply to new registrations and newly issued cards.
settings.consentVersionHint: Change it when the consent text changes, e.g. 2026-11.
settings.ktaValidityHint: Applies to cards issued from now on.
